summary: Comprehensive research notes detailing the decomposition of src/rulesets/dnd35e/srd_registry.ts (1,154 lines) into four single-concern modules (effect_bundle.ts, semantic_tags.ts, archetype_resolver.ts, and srd_registry.ts) and adding a file length warning check script (> 300 lines) integrated into verify.sh and verify.bat. Includes a complete Cascading Effects Matrix and SSOT registry mappings.
